issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds the word 'riêng' (separately/privately) to 'κατ ιδιαν'. While 'ἰδίαν' can imply a private setting, in this context it functions as an adverbial phrase describing the location/manner of the movement ('to a private place'). However, the Vietnamese structure 'đưa họ lên núi cao riêng ra' makes 'riêng' sound like a modifier of the mountain or a separate action, whereas the Greek is 'to a private place'.
